decisionBasis: Every composed pattern carries evidenceStatus vendored-source-verified: its RD source is pinned in platform/rd-baseline and re-checked by validate:snapshot on every run. This pack inherits that rather than claiming capture of its own.
The working view - canvas, playback, timeline - is deliberately left to the feature. It is the one region video tools genuinely differ in, so pinning it here would produce false deviations.
Superseding rather than editing 2026-08 keeps existing approvals valid: a stage transition is bound to the pack hash it was reviewed against.
